findings.title: Flex conversion disables the action button's right float
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container turns its direct `button` children into flex items. Flex items do not honor `float: right`, so the existing rule at line 306 no longer places action buttons on the right; with no `margin-left: auto` or flex growth on the description, buttons will appear immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead. This regresses the layout of small-action controls such as undo/action buttons. Add an explicit flex alignment rule (for example, `margin-left: auto` on the button) if the controls should remain right-aligned.
